description: All-in-one Salesforce sandbox toolkit. Seed data with AI personas, CSV import, or org cloning. Sync orgs with real-time CDC and conflict resolution. Compare metadata, monitor limits, and automate pipelines — with streaming execution for large datasets.
viewContainer.title: SandForge
config.title: SandForge
config.monitor.persistTimeSeries.descrip: Persist Monitor time-series data to disk (~5 min flush, 7-day retention, ~500 KB/org). Off by default.
config.seed.defaultBatchSize.description: Default batch size for Seed data operations
config.sync.defaultBatchSize.description: Default batch size for Sync data operations
config.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI Assistant (requires API key in secrets)
config.ai.provider.description: AI provider for the assistant (anthropic, openai, custom)
config.ai.model.description: AI model to use for the assistant
config.ai.tokenBudgetMaxPerSession.descr: Maximum AI token budget per Assistant panel session. Counter resets when the panel closes. SandForge soft-warns at 80% and hard-refuses further requests at 100%.
config.backup.maxCount.description: Maximum number of backups to retain per org
config.api.retryAttempts.description: Number of retry attempts for failed API calls
config.safety.requireProdConfirmation.de: Require confirmation dialog for production org operations
config.safety.auditLogging.description: Enable audit logging for all data operations
